description: It’s 2008 and You’re Watching MTV is a collection that celebrates the music videos that defined a generation of childhood screen time. Drawing on the bold colors, glossy styling, and unmistakable energy of the era, each piece revisits a video that left a lasting impression. The collection is a tribute to the nostalgia of tuning in, and to the way music television shaped early ideas of style, performance, and pop culture.

prints.title: I've got 5 passports i'm never going to jail.

title: It's 2008 and you're watching MTV

description: The Beautiful Game is a collection that seeks to make football’s beauty visible, not just its competition. It reimagines fandom through the artist’s lens, portraying women in the jerseys of all 48 nations competing in the 2026 World Cup. Each portrait strips the sport back to something quieter and more intimate, presenting national pride as beauty, identity, and belonging rather than rivalry.
title: The Beautiful Game

prints.title: Cos imma Christian and i walk in the blood of Jesus

description: Movie Night is a collection of paintings inspired by some of my favourite films. Each piece recreates a scene that stayed with me, trying to capture the feeling of watching it for the first time: the colors, the light, the mood, and the magic. It’s a tribute to the movies I love, one scene at a time.
title: Movie Night

description: Adumadan is a portrait collection celebrating the radiance of Black and African women across the world. Named after the Yoruba term meaning “one with dark, shiny skin,” the series draws visual inspiration from Ichiro Tsuruta’s graceful, emotive portraits, reinterpreted through an African lens. Each painting honors elegance, strength, and quiet power, capturing skin as light, presence as beauty, and identity as something luminous and worthy of reverence.
title: Adumadan

description: HROS is a collection created during Black History Month 2026 to celebrate some of my favorite Black superheroes.
title: HROS

description: DNCE is a collection exploring the deep-rooted need for African and Black people to dance and move their bodies. Focusing on Caribbean carnivals, Notting Hill Carnival, and Nigerian party dance culture, the collection looks at movement as celebration, expression, and release. Each piece captures the energy of these spaces, where dance is more than entertainment: it is a language, a form of cultural continuity, and a way of claiming joy in community.

prints.title: The dance i danced last night was not enough

title: DNCE

description: MTHR is a collection created for Mother’s Day 2026 as a tribute to motherhood and the women who shape us. Each piece is named after an endearing term for mothers in Yoruba culture, honoring the warmth, love, and respect carried in the language. The collection celebrates mothers as sources of strength, care, and identity, and reflects the cultural weight of the names used to address them.
title: MTHR

description: BLCK is a collection created for Black History Month 2026 that examines the roots of Black American culture and its connections to Africa. Through each piece, the collection traces the similarities in style, expression, tradition, and spirit that link the two, showing how heritage endures across generations and continents. It is a celebration of shared identity and of the threads that continue to connect the African diaspora to its origins.
title: BLCK

description:
From Lagos, With Love
As Valentine's approaches, this collection celebrates love as something deeply human and personal, drawn from the city that shapes my vision: Lagos.
The collection unfolds in three parts:
With Love: Self-love and the quiet moments of affection we give ourselves and others. The tenderness that begins inward.
From Lagos, with Love: Intimacy as it lives in Lagos: unguarded, resilient, woven into the rhythm of crowded danfos, sun-soaked streets, and the spirit of a city that never rests.
Give This to Your Lover — The warmth of leaning in. The vulnerability of giving yourself fully to love, hands open, heart undefended.
This is love as I see it, lived, remembered, offered.
From Lagos, with Love.
title: From lagos, with love

description: Kamoru vs the World is a collection built around a “what if” story: what if Mayowa Alabi had grown up under different conditions? Imagining his life swapped with those of the people he grew up with, the collection asks whether he would still have ended up with a good life. Each piece explores the role of circumstance, opportunity, and chance in shaping who we become, and invites viewers to reflect on how much of any life is made by choice and how much by the conditions we are born into.

prints.title: All Area Boys Go to Heaven i
All Area Boys Go to Heaven ii

title: Kamoru Vs The World

description: Channels is the artist’s first exploration of a signature painting style: vibrant, saturated backgrounds set against dark skin tones and bold highlights. The contrast lets the figures glow, with light and color moving across the skin to celebrate its depth, richness, and radiance. The collection marks the beginning of a visual language that places Black subjects at the center, rendered in color that feels alive.
title: Channels

description: è is the first exploration with translucency, merging my signature painting style with sheer, see-through clothing on the figures. Layers of fabric let light, skin, and color show through one another, adding softness and depth to the portraits. The collection marks a new technical step in the artist’s practice, testing how delicate materials can sit within a bold, vibrant visual language.
title: è

description: We Glow Different is the first exploration of my signature grain shading style applied to colors beyond black. Iridescent lighting wraps around each character, giving the figures a shimmering glow that shifts with the color around them. The collection extends the artist’s visual language into new tones and textures, celebrating the idea that radiance takes many forms.

prints.title: so, please don't stop the music

title: We glow different

description: Flow is a collection exploring how light and iridescence behave on different skin colors and tones. Each figure is caught mid-dance, so the work also looks at how light shifts, bends, and shimmers as the body moves. Every tone responds to light in its own way, and every movement changes how that light is seen.
title: Flow

description: A painting for every Arsenal match of the 2026/27 season, made before kickoff. Each piece captures the mood and anticipation of the day, from the first game in August to the last whistle in May. Together they form a season-long visual diary of the fixtures, the atmosphere, and the hope that comes with every matchday.
title: Match day - 26/27

description: Christmas looks different in every home. This collection gathers stories from around the season: crowded family dinners where old rivalries simmer beside the jollof, lovers finding each other (or losing each other) under the lights, and those who spend the day alone, learning that solitude can be its own kind of celebration. Warm, funny, bittersweet, and honest, these are tales of what Keresimesi means to the people who live it.

prints.title: Twas christmas and everybody was home

title: Keresimesi (Christmas)
